<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed, ref } from "vue";
import {
  PopoverArrow,
  PopoverArrowTip,
  PopoverContent,
  PopoverPositioner,
  PopoverRoot,
  PopoverTrigger,
} from "@ark-ui/vue/popover";
import { Portal } from "@ark-ui/vue/portal";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

type PopoverSide = "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left";
type PopoverAlign = "start" | "center" | "end";

const props = withDefaults(
  defineProps<{
    modelValue?: boolean;
    defaultOpen?: boolean;
    side?: PopoverSide;
    align?: PopoverAlign;
    offset?: number;
    collisionPadding?: number;
    dismissible?: boolean;
    autoFocus?: boolean;
    matchTriggerWidth?: boolean;
    bare?: boolean;
    arrow?: boolean;
    class?: string;
  }>(),
  {
    side: "bottom",
    align: "center",
    offset: 8,
    collisionPadding: 8,
    dismissible: true,
    autoFocus: true,
    matchTriggerWidth: false,
    bare: false,
    arrow: false,
  },
);

const emit = defineEmits<{
  "update:modelValue": [value: boolean];
  open: [];
  close: [];
}>();

const slots = defineSlots<{
  trigger?: (props: { open: boolean; close: () => void }) => unknown;
  default?: (props: { open: boolean; close: () => void }) => unknown;
}>();

const internalOpen = ref(props.defaultOpen ?? false);
const isOpen = computed(() => props.modelValue ?? internalOpen.value);

const positioning = computed(() => ({
  placement: props.align === "center" ? props.side : `${props.side}-${props.align}`,
  gutter: props.offset,
  overflowPadding: props.collisionPadding,
}));

function setOpen(value: boolean) {
  if (props.modelValue === undefined) internalOpen.value = value;
  emit("update:modelValue", value);
  if (value) emit("open");
  else emit("close");
}
</script>

<template>
  <PopoverRoot
    :open="isOpen"
    :auto-focus="props.autoFocus"
    :close-on-interact-outside="props.dismissible"
    :close-on-escape="props.dismissible"
    :positioning="positioning"
    :lazy-mount="true"
    :unmount-on-exit="true"
    @open-change="(details: { open: boolean }) => setOpen(details.open)"
  >
    <slot name="trigger" :open="isOpen" :close="() => setOpen(false)">
      <PopoverTrigger as-child>
        <button type="button" class="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-ink-gray-8">
          Open
        </button>
      </PopoverTrigger>
    </slot>

    <Portal>
      <PopoverPositioner
        data-slot="popover-positioner"
        class="[--z-index:50]!"
        :style="props.matchTriggerWidth ? { minWidth: 'var(--reference-width)' } : undefined"
      >
        <PopoverContent
          data-slot="popover-content"
          :class="
            cn(
              'rounded-4 border border-outline-gray-2 bg-surface-base p-3 shadow-lg outline-none',
              props.bare && 'border-0 bg-transparent p-0 shadow-none',
              props.class,
            )
          "
        >
          <slot :open="isOpen" :close="() => setOpen(false)" />
          <PopoverArrow v-if="props.arrow" data-slot="popover-arrow" class="text-surface-base">
            <PopoverArrowTip
              data-slot="popover-arrow-tip"
              class="size-2 rotate-45 rounded-[2px] border border-outline-gray-2 bg-surface-base"
            />
          </PopoverArrow>
        </PopoverContent>
      </PopoverPositioner>
    </Portal>
  </PopoverRoot>
</template>
